notes: Two taḥwīl branches meet at al-Danaj (branch 1) and Ibn Fayruz (branch 2): written as the text writes them, not merged (rule 9). The names written after the last «ح» form the shared tail.
Uthman is the last link: his words are the saying, and Hudayn «شهدت» him (rule 6). Ali, Hasan and Ibn Ja'far speak only in the scene.
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss; «قال إسماعيل وقد سمعت حديث الداناج منه» and «زاد علي بن حجر» are remarks, not routes.
